trust_decision.summary: The glob compiler decides whether an untrusted pattern's repeated extglob (+(...) / *(...)) is compiled into a regex quantifier group; at the pinned commit extglobClose always emits the quantified group, with no ambiguity/nesting check, so the regex returned by makeRe/isMatch can backtrack catastrophically.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'extglob quantifiers'; extglobClose is where the +( / *( close output is produced, and extglobOpen (lib/parse.js:222) is right above it.

fix_sites.entry_point: same; extglobOpen records startIndex/tokensIndex used for literalization (fix.diff:364-365)

same; new analyzer helpers splitTopLevel/normalizeSimpleBranch/hasRepeatedCharPrefixOverlap/parseRepeatedExtglob/getStarExtglobSequenceOutput/analyzeRepeatedExtglob inserted after syntaxError (fix.diff:86-355)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All source changes are in lib/parse.js plus one constant in lib/constants.js; no second implementation, wrapper or serialization path is touched. lib/scan.js does not build regexes; parse.fastpaths (lib/parse.js:999-1083) never emits extglobs.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 routes: `)+` after a group / brace / @() is a documented intentional regex feature (README.md:360, test/regex-features.js:33), not an extglob quantifier, and the advisory is titled 'via extglob quantifiers'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Non-ambiguous extglobs must still compile to regex: +(abc), *(foo|bar), *(*(f)*(o)), +(*)c, and regex-quantifier groups like (*)/(\1)+; an over-broad fix that literalizes every +(/*( or every ')+' breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: ambiguous alternation inside +( ) e.g. +(a|aa) (prefix-overlap of repeated char)
nested repeated extglobs +(+(a)), *(+(a)) bounded by maxExtglobRecursion
risky extglob embedded mid-pattern (foo/+(a|aa)/bar, x+(a|aa)y) and adjacent to other extglobs (+(a|aa)@(x))

O7_producer.where: Regex source is produced in-line by parse() token outputs (lib/parse.js:981-987 backtrack rebuild); no separate schema/serializer/cache.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: @(a|aa)+ : the '@' extglob is not opened through extglobOpen, '(' is a plain paren, and the following '+' after a paren is emitted raw as a regex quantifier, giving (a|aa)+ that the fix's plus/star-only check never sees.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Trailing '+' after a group is the documented regex feature, not an extglob quantifier; fix only targets type plus/star.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: (a|aa)+ : plain parentheses with a raw '+' quantifier (default regex option undefined) compile to an ambiguous quantified group.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: README documents regex rules for '+' after ')' and examples/tests rely on it (test/regex-features.js:33).

O8_uncovered_routes.route: {a,aa}+ : brace alternation becomes (a|aa) and the following '+' after a brace token is emitted raw.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Brace expansion is a neighbouring feature, not extglob.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the '?(' (qmark) and '@(' extglob types could get a repeated-form check the plus/star rule skips (e.g. nesting +(@(a|aa)), where normalizeSimpleBranch only unwraps @() bodies without '|').
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fix's normalizeSimpleBranch regex (fix.diff:167) deliberately excludes '|', so a maintainer could plausibly ship an unwrap that misses alternation inside @().

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the negate-extglob path re-parses the remainder with a fresh options object; a copy that drops maxExtglobRecursion would reopen the hole on '!(x).+(a|aa)' style tails.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The nested parse already spreads options with an override (fastpaths:false), the natural spot for an options-filtering mistake.

O10_build.project_tests: test/extglobs*.js, test/regex-features.js, test/parens.js, test/malicious.js; fix adds test/options.maxExtglobRecursion.js

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Literalize or reject every +( / *( containing '|' or nesting inside extglobClose, which breaks +(abc)/*(foo|bar) and leaves @(a|aa)+ and (a|aa)+ open.
